about: Pashto narration for Colours, laid over the pages and pictures of the English Curious Reader book ColoursLevel2En (the recordings are its 10 short sentences: 'Bear likes colours.' ... 'No more colours.'; the Digital Library book ColoursPashto is the longer Lv4 story and its text is not used). Page numbers are body indexes of the converted English book (0 = first story page; this book has no title page). The sentence files are named in English, so every line was written from the word clips (file names give the speaker's spelling) in story order and confirmed against a Whisper transcription of each sentence. The speaker's dialect says 'bear' as یگه / ږیره (the Digital Library book writes ییږ), so the text follows the clip spellings; all lines need checking by a Pashto reader. 'link' lists the Pashto words that trigger the page's picture (replacing the English glow hotspots, same word positions).
